mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5pp over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which will pressure consumer spending and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average, it signals strong supply-side momentum that will support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 12mo MA but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising and the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) is above 3%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will pressure equity valuations and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL > 3% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are declining and retail sales (RSAFS) are below their 6-month moving average, it signals weakening consumer demand that will pressure corporate earnings and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST declining and RSAFS < 6mo MA but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) is rising, it signals a tight labor market that will support wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS rising but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over 3 months signals a supply shock that will pressure corporate margins and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO drops > 2% in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will pressure equity valuations and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL rising but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.
